thread:
Maya L.: Heads-up: spike in GPU attach fails in europe-west3 starting ~1717800000. Lots of pods stuck at "waiting for device". NVMe io latency and temp sensor blips reported.
Sam T.: seeing same. Attach success rate from 98% -> 61%. Kube device-plugin logs show timeouts.
Ibrahim H.: quick query: janitor/scrub backlog is elevated there, depth ~1200. Could be background writes saturating qdepth.
ops-bot: [ALERT] gpu_attach_rate_drop europe-west3 threshold breached (60% -> 35%).
Sam T.: dmesg snippet:
```
[1717800180] nvme0: I/O 0x1f4 timed out, qdepth 128
[1717800181] nvmemanager: controller reset
```
Sam T.: classic io starvation pattern.
Jules R.: short-term mitigation: throttle scrub concurrency to 1 per-host and reduce scrub batch to 48. Also set device-plugin threads to SCHED_BATCH and lower io_priority for scrub worker.
Ibrahim H.: I'll roll a 5% canary with those settings now.
Maya L.: monitor attach rate + GPU idle minutes. If recover, schedule infra task to add workload-aware janitor pacing and an attach-priority IO path.
ops-bot: [INFO] canary-deploy scrub-throttle-eu-west3 started by Ibrahim H.
Sam T.: attach failures dropping: 60 -> 12 in last 10m. Looks promising.
Maya L.: thanks team. Track follow-ups in INFRA-3421 for pacing + monitoring tweaks. Thread closed.
